$description: Tenon semantic colour, OFFDESK theme: Concrete ground, Ink type and actions, and Safety orange kept to the one signal, never a button or a link. Brand roles come from OFFDESK's brand stylesheet (brand/AGENTS/design-md/assets/ofd-brand.css, 5 Nov 2026) and its DESIGN.md. Every value the brand does not state says "Derived" and what from. OFFDESK has no status colours, so those take Tenon ramps, stepped from the light theme's picks until the build's contrast rules pass. Corners and shadows are in radius.offdesk.json and below. Same key set as light; scripts/build.mjs fails if it drifts.

raised.$description: Brand: white, the neutral surface for panels (--ofd-surface-neutral).
